resources.string: Choose a notification sound, vibration and lock-screen visibility in Android settings. Full-screen alerts require your permission and may be limited by Do Not Disturb, battery settings or a force-stopped app.
App notifications are disabled in Android settings
This notification channel is silent or low priority; enable pop-up alerts in Android settings
Full-screen alerts appear when your phone is locked or its screen is off, if Android allows them. While you are using the phone, Android may show a heads-up notification instead.
For urgent disaster check-ins only. Uses your existing alarm volume for a limited time while the check-in screen is visible. Stops when you touch the screen.
Available within system permissions. Do Not Disturb and alarm volume remain under your control.
Check alarm volume, notification permissions and Do Not Disturb. System restrictions are respected.
In Android accessibility settings, enable flash notifications if supported by your phone. Android controls flash alerts, including while the app is closed.
